paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the learning rate of a reward model across training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1400, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Learning Rate" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 2.00, accompanied by a 1e-6 multiplier at the top of the axis, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.25. A single solid blue line with no markers represents the "Learning Rate of Reward Model." The line begins at an initial value of approximately 0.1 x 1e-6 at training step 0 and rapidly spikes to a peak of 2.00 x 1e-6 at roughly step 40. After reaching this peak, the line exhibits a smooth, continuous, convex decline, falling steadily to reach approximately 0.00 x 1e-6 around training step 1360, maintaining this near-zero value through the remainder of the plotted x-axis.
